svg.text: This standard plan applies to installations in accordance with MPP
Section 344 for Continental Crosswalks for new and reinstallations of
marked crosswalks on signalized and stop-controlled approaches.
Typical crosswalk widths are 15 feet but may vary according to site
conditions. Continental markings shall be installed within existing
dimensions unless otherwise indicated on a signed plan.
Install 2' wide white or yellow markings
along striping. Center the markings on
DYCL and lane lines. Add markings
